## Must fix (Critical)
- [x] `src/core/svg.ts:381-397` + `src/core/url/Url.ts:32-40` — `[[javascript:...]]` reaches `<a href>` unfiltered. Upstream strips it by default (`SecurityUtils.java:88` `ignoreThisLink`, called at `SvgGraphics.java:1137`, opt-in via `PLANTUML_ALLOW_JAVASCRIPT_IN_LINK`). Fix: port `SecurityUtils.ignoreThisLink`/`isJavascriptLink` and apply it where `linkWrap` emits `href`; add a `[[javascript:alert(1)]]` probe to `tests/unit/core/attribute-injection.test.ts`.
- [x] `src/core/include-resolver.ts:165-216` — `render()` defaults to an unrestricted `fetch(url)` for any `!include http://…` in untrusted source (SSRF for Node consumers). Upstream gates this with `SecurityProfile` (SANDBOX/ALLOWLIST/INTERNET). Fix: require an explicit `options.fetcher` for network includes (no built-in network default), or port a security-profile gate; document in `DIVERGENCES.md`.
- [x] `src/diagrams/board/renderer.ts:45` — `Math.random()` builds the shadow filter id in a render path (CLAUDE.md forbids it; non-deterministic SVG, duplicate-id risk). Fix: derive the id with `hashString` (`src/core/paint.ts:169`) from stable input.
- [x] `packages/*/package.json` (all 7) — `peerDependencies["@knowvah/plantuml-ts"]: "^0.1.0"` while root is `0.2.0`; `^0.1.0` excludes 0.2.0, so installs fail ERESOLVE on first publish. Fix: bump to `^0.2.0`; add a test asserting peer ranges satisfy the root version.
